verdict.rationale: Airweave is an agent context and retrieval layer, so memory freshness and conflict handling is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence only documents syncing source data into searchable collections. Nothing shows the product updating, superseding, or merging stored memories when new information contradicts old. Automatic source syncing is a related but different behavior and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on the memory layer to update, supersede, or merge memories when new information contradicts what was stored
